solve_sdp_dual_simple: run SDP dual optimization with a simple interface to compute verified lower bounds on neural network outputs
solve_sdp_dual: run SDP dual optimization with advanced hyperparameters including learning rate scheduling and diagnostic statistics
dual_fun: compute the dual objective value for SDP verification given dual variables and a verification instance
init_duals_ibp: initialize dual variables using a closed-form solution that recovers the IBP (Interval Backpropagation) bound
project_duals: project dual variables to satisfy dual constraints by enforcing non-negativity on inequality-type variables
